reason: For a legal input, the laws fix the new registry. KeepsPrefix gives r ++ t. AddsOnlyAbsent and AddsAllAbsent make t contain exactly the absent starter rows by id, adapter and model. Distinct starter ids and KeepsStarterOrder (a sublist of a duplicate-free id list) give the order with no repeats. NewDisabled, LockedDisabled and EnableKeepsState fix every enabled flag. So two passing designs give the same registry.
